description: Dispatch an async job that re-reads the marketo_instance address-book entry and mints an OAuth bearer token against the identity endpoint, and return {job_id, status} in milliseconds; poll check_marketo_job_status(job_id) for the finished ok, base_url, client_id.
embedding_description: Verify ONLY that Marketo credentials are reachable — mint a bearer token against the configured instance, confirming the marketo_instance address-book entry is complete and the client_id/client_secret are valid. Does NOT check what the API user's Role can actually DO; for that, run check_setup instead. Diagnostic only, no marketing data touched.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id (pass to check_marketo_job_status) and status 'queued'. The completed job result is a dict with ok (bool), base_url, client_id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A queued job is not a verified connection: give the job_id and poll check_marketo_job_status. Report the connection as verified only once the job completed with ok=true, naming the base_url and client_id it checked.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Never say the credentials work from THIS verb's response -- it carries only the job handle; an address-book or credential fault surfaces only in check_marketo_job_status's error field.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job that verifies the configured Marketo instance is reachable.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Refused at dispatch with no job created: marketo.invalid_params when session_id/flow_id are missing from the calling context. Reported later in check_marketo_job_status's error field: marketo.not_configured: no marketo_instance address-book entry registered yet, or it lacks base_url/client_id/client_secret (the message says which). marketo.auth_failed: the OAuth client_id/client_secret were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.not_configured: register the marketo_instance address-book entry (see hydration_guidance.md); the error message carries an example registration. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the LaunchPoint custom service's client_id/client_secret.
